because: Under the Arbois cahier des charges, vin jaune stays in oak without topping up until 15 December of the sixth year after the harvest, with at least 60 months of that under voile. From harvest that is about six years and three months, not six years. The stem asks for both the total and the months under voile, but the grader accepts a bare 'six years', which is short of the legal minimum and says nothing about the voile.
fix: Remove "six years" from accept; keep "six years and three months", "6 years 3 months", "75 months".
